x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first read-only lexical-audit helper used the Windows default console encoding and stopped when printing the word Māori after six candidate rows.
x1_execution_negatives.resolution: Rerun the same read-only audit with explicit UTF-8 output; all ten rows and the maximum score were then produced.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first privacy pattern set matched prohibition labels such as session streams and a phase-index tool name containing screenshot rather than concrete private payloads.
x1_execution_negatives.resolution: Refine the scanner to concrete identifiers, values, route schemes, local path values, credential forms, image payloads, transcript fields, and session-stream filenames; the full x1 packet then returned zero hits.

boundary: Lexical distance does not prove conceptual uniqueness. Each proposal remains withdrawable or splittable if later evidence reveals a material collision.
